question.question: A healthcare professional raises a concern about patient adherence. The product has an approved benefit related to dosing convenience. What is the most appropriate way to communicate its value?

options.text: Explain how the approved dosing benefit relates to the adherence concern and communicate the relevant safety information
options.value: Explain how the approved dosing benefit relates to the adherence concern and communicate the relevant safety information

options.text: Describe dosing convenience as a broad solution to adherence challenges across diverse groups of patients
options.value: Describe dosing convenience as a broad solution to adherence challenges across diverse groups of patients

options.text: Focus on the dosing benefit first and discuss safety information only if asked
options.value: Focus on the dosing benefit first and discuss safety information only if asked

options.text: Explain all product benefits and let the healthcare professional decide which is relevant
options.value: Explain all product benefits and let the healthcare professional decide which is relevant
